name: econ-earth-buy
notes: No buying from Earth (user, 2026-10-13). Vanilla prices a missing space resource as boost + money from Earth for the aliens too. If the aliens really pay it, their boost income is spent as it arrives (stock ~0, as in every run so far); with the mod they can't, so boost accumulates and shortfalls are refused. Run on vanilla first: if alien boost income is 0, vanilla never actually buys and the switch only guards the lore.
info: [(e['t'], e['boost'], e['boostIncome'], e['money'], e['moneyIncome'], e['earthShortfalls'], e['earthBlocked']) for e in events('economy')]
[(e['t'], e['stock']['Metals'], e['stock']['NobleMetals']) for e in events('economy')]
